anusotagāmī.cp: adj. one who follows the stream.
anusotagāmī.p: [Anusota+gamu+ṇī] (ti) CL=8 1) Drifting in down-stream A) The person who drifts over the down-stream water-flow, drifts over the flow of water. B) The person who appropriately drifts over the flow of cycle C) The person who drifts together with the flow of water
